title: Fluted columns, *moon-cut* beads
hero_alt: Close view of the 3945 Colonne bracelet: fluted pipes between moon-cut beads
dek: Inside the Colonne collection: three designs built on architectural pipes.

body.html: Colonne takes its name from the column. Its pipes are fluted like classical stone, with fine grooves that run their whole length and catch the light in parallel lines.

In 3945 Colonne, the pipes alternate with moon-cut Lune beads, each parted by a thin Disque spacer. 3947 Fuseau swaps the columns for spindles, with Halo rondelles framing a pineapple-cut Pavé sphere. 4023 Octave sets eight-sided batons between star-cut Étoile cubes.
All three are made in yellow 916 gold first. 3945 is also made in tri-tone, with white and rose gold among the yellow; in tri-tone it weighs about 6.45 g.
